summary: Iteration 9: Full i18n feature verification for TR/EN/DE/RU/AR. Frontend: lang-toggle opens lang-menu with 5 options; DE/RU/AR switch updates html.lang and html.dir (rtl for AR only); hero + nav + footer + cookie banner translate correctly (LEGENDÄRER GESCHMACK, ЛЕГЕНДАРНЫЙ ВКУС, مذاق أسطوري). Persistence works — reload preserves DE. /menu DE shows 'Unsere Karte', placeholder 'In der Karte suchen...', 'Alle' chip; translated item name 'Ofenkartoffel' displayed once backend field set. /iletisim DE shows Telefon/Adresse/E-Mail/Öffnungszeiten. /galeri RU shows 'Галерея'. Mobile 390x844: mobile-lang-toggle inside hamburger menu opens lang-menu; switching to DE translates all mobile nav links (Startseite, Speisekarte, Über Uns, Galerie, Kontakt) and cookie banner. Backend: PUT /api/admin/items/{id} with name_de/name_ru/name_ar/description_de returns 200 {ok:true}; GET /api/menu returns those fields on the item. Admin UI: item edit form shows trans-lang-en/de/ru/ar tabs; DE data persists. NO pageerror, NO error-boundary, NO uncaught console errors across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: SiteContext localName/localDesc fallback pattern is clean: (lang !== 'tr' && item[`name_${lang}`]) || item.name — correctly falls back to TR when translation empty (as designed).
LangMenu dropdown does not close on outside click (only on re-toggle or option select); acknowledged by main agent as known minor UX quirk, not a bug.

MenuItem model in backend exposes name_en/description_en explicitly but name_de/ru/ar and description_de/ru/ar only appear in response if set on the document (Mongo-level absence). Consistent, but consider defaulting to null for uniform response schema.
html[dir=rtl] letter-spacing:0 rule preserves Arabic ligatures — good.
test_credentials: Admin session created via mongosh (role:admin) then cleaned up. See /app/auth_testing.md.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set name_de='Ofenkartoffel', name_ru, name_ar, description_de on Kumpir item; reverted to null after test. Test user/session removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n feature is fully working end-to-end (frontend + backend + admin). Menu item content stays TR when translation field empty — this is by design (fallback). Reservation still disabled; expect 403 on POST /api/reservations. Admin auth via mongosh session per /app/auth_testing.md. Dropdown outside-click-close is a known UX quirk, not a bug.
